Presenting the brand new song "Danka Baja" from the upcoming Bollywood movie "Mumbai Saga" in the voice of “Dev Negi". The music of the new song is composed by Payal Dev & lyrics are penned by Prashant Ingole.
Mumbai Saga, directed by Sanjay Gupta, produced by Bhushan Kumar and Krishan Kumar (T-Series), Anuradha Gupta (White Feather Films), and Sangeeta Ahir releases on March 19, 2021.
